newsitem.title: USA: Arvida/JMB Partners LP financing blocked.
newsitem.headline: Arvida/JMB Partners LP financing blocked.

text.p: Arvida/JMB Partners LP, a Boca Raton, Fla.-based residential developer, said that it was blocked from completing a planned $160 million term loan financing with Starwood/Florida Funding LLC.
The partnership said the transaction ran into opposition from Raleigh Capital Associates LP and affiliates, among others.
As a result of the Starwood financing not proceeding, Arvida/JMB Partners said it would not be able to distribute to interest holders a planned $350 per interest.

Arvida/JMB noted that in October Raleigh began an unsolicited offer to acquire up to 100,000 interests in the partnership, or 24.8 percent, at $500 per interest. The Raleigh offer is scheduled to expire on December 19.
A special committee of the Arvida/JMP general partnership in a statement reiterated its determination that the Raleigh offer is inadequate.

But the committee did recommend that interestholders who have a current need for liquidity tender their interests in the Raleigh offer. It cited the likelihood that Raleigh will continue to block any of the general partner's efforts to provide liquidity to interestholders.

In addition, once the Raleigh offer has expired, the price for interests through privately negotiated sales and sales through intermediaries may be less than the purchase price under the Raleigh offer.
Arvida/JMP Partners is affiliated with JMB Realty Corp.
